source_text_en: Shang Han Lun (Treatise on Cold Damage)
category_en: Formulas that Release the Exterior - Warm, Acrid

glance.plain_summary_zh: 最常用於感冒或流感初期，惡寒重、無汗、全身痠痛時——身體需要一股強力把邪氣推出去的時候。
glance.plain_summary_en: Most often used for the early stages of a cold or flu with strong chills, no sweating and aching muscles - when the body needs a powerful push to expel the pathogen outward.

composition.role_reason_zh: 發汗解表，宣肺平喘——本方的推動力
composition.role_reason_en: Releases the exterior, promotes sweating, opens the Lung and stops wheezing - the driving force of the formula

composition.role_reason_zh: 溫通經脈、解肌發表，助麻黃透達營衛，發汗之力倍增
composition.role_reason_en: Warms the channels and releases the muscle layer, carrying ying and wei outward so Ma Huang's diaphoretic action is doubled

composition.role_reason_zh: 降肺氣，止咳平喘——與麻黃一宣一降，恢復肺的宣降之常
composition.role_reason_en: Descends Lung qi and stops cough and wheezing - one ascends and one descends with Ma Huang, restoring the Lung's normal diffusing-and-descending function

composition.role_reason_zh: 調和諸藥，緩麻黃、桂枝之峻烈，防過汗傷正
composition.role_reason_en: Harmonises the formula and moderates the harshness of Ma Huang and Gui Zhi, guarding against over-sweating

key_pairs_note_zh: 麻黃配桂枝（相須）決定本方發汗解表的方向；麻黃配杏仁（相使）負責宣降平喘。理解這兩對，就理解了麻黃湯。
key_pairs_note_en: Ma Huang with Gui Zhi (mutual accentuation) sets the formula's exterior-releasing direction; Ma Huang with Xing Ren (mutual enhancement) does the diffusing-and-descending work. Understand these two pairs and you understand the formula.
fang_yi_zh: 本方為辛溫發汗之峻劑。麻黃開腠發汗、宣肺平喘為君；桂枝助其發汗、解肌溫經為臣；杏仁降氣止咳、與麻黃相配一宣一降為佐；炙甘草調和並緩其峻烈為使。四味配伍嚴謹，發汗而不致過汗，宣降並行。
fang_yi_en: A forceful warm-acrid diaphoretic formula. Ma Huang opens the interstices, promotes sweating and calms wheezing as chief; Gui Zhi assists the sweating and warms the channels as deputy; Xing Ren descends qi and stops cough, pairing with Ma Huang as one-up-one-down, as assistant; honey-fried Gan Cao harmonises and moderates the harshness as envoy. Tightly constructed - it sweats without over-sweating, and diffuses and descends at the same time.
actions_en: Releases the exterior by inducing sweating
Diffuses Lung qi and calms wheezing

indications.clinical_picture_zh: 惡寒重、發熱輕、無汗、頭痛、身疼腰痛、骨節疼痛、項強、或見喘
indications.clinical_picture_en: Strong chills with mild fever, absence of sweating, headache, body and lower back aches, joint pain, stiff neck, sometimes wheezing

constitutional_note_zh: 此處指本方須慎用的體質傾向，非適應體質。
constitutional_note_en: These flag constitutions requiring caution, not constitutions the formula suits.

modifications.change_zh: 加重杏仁用量，或加蘇子、桑白皮降氣平喘
modifications.change_en: Increase Xing Ren, or add Su Zi and Sang Bai Pi to direct qi downward

modifications.if_en: With interior heat, restlessness and thirst
modifications.change_zh: 加石膏——即大青龍湯法，方向由治寒轉為兼清裡熱
modifications.change_en: Add Shi Gao - the Da Qing Long Tang method; the formula turns from treating cold to also clearing interior heat
Add Ban Xia and Chen Pi to transform phlegm

modifications.change_zh: 全方減量；麻黃改用麻黃絨；必要時配補氣藥護正
modifications.change_en: Reduce the whole formula; substitute Ma Huang Rong for Ma Huang; add qi tonics to protect the upright qi if needed

dose_adjustment_note_zh: 服後溫覆取微汗，中病即止，不可令大汗淋漓——過汗傷陽耗津。一服汗出即停後服。兒童按年齡體重酌減。
dose_adjustment_note_en: Cover warmly after taking and aim for a slight sweat only. Stop as soon as the sweat comes - profuse sweating damages yang and consumes fluids. If sweating occurs after one dose, do not take the remainder. Reduce for children by age and weight.
contraindications_zh: 溫病初起、風熱表證非本方所宜
contraindications_en: Contraindicated in exterior deficiency with spontaneous sweating
Contraindicated in yin deficiency and blood deficiency
Contraindicated with hypertension or heart disease
Not for warm-disease onset or Wind-Heat exterior patterns

comparisons.differentiator_zh: 同屬太陽病、同為辛溫解表，關鍵在汗：麻黃湯治表實無汗、脈浮緊；桂枝湯治表虛有汗、惡風、脈浮緩。有汗用麻黃湯會過汗傷正。
comparisons.differentiator_en: Both are Tai Yang, both warm-acrid exterior-releasing; the discriminator is sweating. Ma Huang Tang treats exterior EXCESS without sweating, floating tight pulse. Gui Zhi Tang treats exterior DEFICIENCY with sweating that brings no relief, aversion to wind, floating moderate pulse. Using Ma Huang Tang where there is already sweating over-sweats and damages the upright qi.

comparisons.differentiator_zh: 皆有麻黃桂枝。麻黃湯純治外寒表實；小青龍湯外寒兼內飲，見咳喘痰稀色白量多。
comparisons.differentiator_en: Both contain Ma Huang and Gui Zhi. Ma Huang Tang treats exterior cold alone; Xiao Qing Long Tang treats exterior cold WITH interior thin-fluid retention - cough and wheezing with copious watery white phlegm.

comparisons.differentiator_zh: 同有麻黃杏仁。麻黃湯配桂枝故治寒；本方以石膏易桂枝故治熱——同一味麻黃，配伍決定方向。
comparisons.differentiator_en: Both contain Ma Huang and Xing Ren. Ma Huang Tang pairs Ma Huang with Gui Zhi and so treats cold; this formula swaps Shi Gao for Gui Zhi and so treats heat. Same Ma Huang - the partner sets the direction.
